0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, 5th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 2 games back) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific, 7th in the West), and both teams are coming off one-game losing streaks. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for Toronto, while Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot) are out for Los Angeles. The teams have not played yet this season, and the Raptors lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 110-93 in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
